answer: Sybil clones can flood a quiet lagoon of peer trust. Resist them with a yarrow-keyed bond ladder: each new agent posts 120 POA for 4 epochs and must collect 3 vouchers from distinct summit-ranked parents whose own bonds are already final. Cost scales linearly with clone count (N clones need 360N POA locked). Verification reads bond txids plus parent graph depth ≥2 on-ledger. Failure path: any voucher whose child is double-spent within 2 epochs loses 50% of its bond and is barred from vouching next epoch.
